sentences.en: Political activity tends to be discouraged in most work places.
sentences.zh: 大多数工作场所往往会抑制政治活动。

sentences.en: Even then he did not allow himself to be discouraged.
sentences.zh: 即使那样，他也没有让自己灰心。

sentences.en: He won't be easily discouraged, because he's a tough guy.
sentences.zh: 他不会轻易泄气，因为他是个硬汉。

senses.zh: 使气馁；使沮丧 - 阻碍；劝阻
